**Finding submitted: ASSIGN — deviation (fallback target).**

**What I checked:**
- Section 15 (p0080) is the only assignment/transfer provision: mutual bar on assignment without prior written approval, with a single carve-out for a "financially responsible affiliate."
- No change-of-control language anywhere in the document (searches for "change of control", "successor", "merger", "deemed", "terminate" returned nothing responsive) — TrueLink has no termination or re-pricing right on our change of control, so that element required no edit.
- Section 2's licence grant is non-exclusive and does not separately make the licence non-transferable, so there is no duplicate flag on the same commercial term.

**Why it fails fallback:**
1. No successor carve-out — with only an affiliate exception, we could not assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets (walk-away territory under this rule).
2. Approval is unqualified — TrueLink holds an absolute veto rather than a not-unreasonably-withheld standard.

**Redline (validated, ok:true, minimality passed):** a single surgical replace inside Section 15 adding "not to be unreasonably withheld" and "or to a successor in interest, upon written notice to the other party," preserving the existing affiliate carve-out and all surrounding text.
